name: Amount And Currency Exchange Details 5
definition: Set of elements used to provide information on the original amount and currency exchange.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency as ordered by the initiating party.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Set of elements used to provide details on the currency exchange.
